prompt:
For screen recordings I need to see an agent work. Today a session's tabs open in the background, and anything that comes to the front is handed back to my tab, so a recording shows nothing happening.

Add a demo-only "show tabs" mode to the extension. A client asks for it when it connects: the host will send `{ type: "client", event: "connected", client: { id, name, ..., showTabs: true } }`. I'll wire up the host and MCP server myself; calls keep carrying only `client: { id, name }`. For a session whose calls come from such a client:

- every tab the session opens (tabs_create_mcp, or the first tab that navigate or tabs_context_mcp createIfEmpty open for it) opens selected, and its window is raised, even when I'm in another Firefox window;
- if I click over to another tab, the session's next call on one of its tabs selects that tab again, whatever the call is (reading the page counts, not only clicks and typing);
- a tab one of its pages opens (target=_blank, window.open) is left in front, instead of focus going back to the tab that was selected.

Nothing else changes. With two Claude Code clients connected, A with showTabs and B without, A's tabs_create_mcp switches the window to its new tab, while B's leaves me where I was, B's calls don't touch the selection, and focus is still handed back when B's page opens a tab. Once A disconnects, its session is an ordinary one again, including after it reconnects without showTabs.

The existing tests should keep passing as they are.

checks.name: existing_extension_tests_pass
checks.cmd: node --test --test-skip-pattern='replay_steps stops at|Teach records the viewed tab|group shows (idle|needs-you)|a tab Teach is recording|Ask about this page puts|interactive. answers once the new page|interactive. to the same document|a click that opens no tab answers at once|a tab the page opens after the click answered|a tab the page opened before the click' extension/test/background.test.js extension/test/control.test.js extension/test/devtools.test.js extension/test/fanout.test.js extension/test/find-rank.test.js extension/test/focus.test.js extension/test/frame-offset.test.js extension/test/gif.test.js extension/test/names.test.js extension/test/redact.test.js & a=$!; node --test --test-name-pattern='replay_steps stops at|Teach records the viewed tab|group shows (idle|needs-you)|a tab Teach is recording|Ask about this page puts' extension/test/background.test.js & b=$!; wait $a; ra=$?; wait $b; rb=$?; test $ra -eq 0 -a $rb -eq 0
